name: churn-prevention
description: Reduce churn for subscription businesses with five skills, each computed from your own data. Start from "customers keep cancelling": split failed payments from chosen cancellations and see which to fix first. Audit a cancellation flow (cancel flow) against dated cancellation rules for the US, the EU and the UK; judge a save offer by who still pays after the discount ends, against a holdout; sort failed payments by decline code into never retry, customer must act, and retry within card-network limits (dunning); check which churn warning signs came before cancellations in your own history, with coverage and lead time; plan a consent-checked win-back for cancelled subscriptions. Reads what you paste, quotes no benchmarks, and never makes cancelling harder. Not legal advice.
